document_description: Read `.claude/commands/eap-appr-merge.md` for the full workflow. Before merging: verify working tree is clean and no open issues exist. Preview incoming commits before executing. Use `--no-ff` for feature branch merges. If merging into main, warn and confirm. Help resolve conflicts interactively — never abort without asking.
